data.narrative:
Manna Aero is a Series B-stage drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $110M to date. The addressable comp universe in Drones & Autonomous consists of 8 private firms (including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayave, Zipline, and Joby Aviation) and no public comparables, reflecting the nascent maturity of the sector.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression analysis. This approach applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $110M raised proxy, reflecting typical Series B to subsequent-stage mark-ups. This yields an implied valuation of $209M. A Peer-Median triangulation was not feasible due to insufficient narrow peer coverage—while 7 same-sector peers exist, only 1 operated at the same stage and none at adjacent stages or similar valuation tier, falling short of the 3-datapoint minimum required for reliable cross-sectional comparison.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $178M (low) to $240M (high), with $209M as the median point. This 35% spread around the median reflects the reliance on a single methodological anchor and the sparse comp landscape. Key uncertainties include the absence of recent comparable financings at Manna Aero's exact stage and tier, the heterogeneity of drone/autonomous business models and deployment stages across peers, and limited public market reference points for sector-level revenue multiples or profitability benchmarks.
